feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 6:08am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, gales for time.


##Wind)##

NE 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the south of the area, backing NW 6 to gale 8. Decreasing W or NW 5 or 6 early Friday night, then W or SW 4 or 5 for a time, before increasing SW 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, building moderate or rough through the morning, then decreasing slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Heavy rain clearing to isolated showers in the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, becoming good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Gales/ severe gales.


##Wind)##

West or SW 4 or 5, backing and increasing South 7 to severe gale 9 through morning, then veering West or SW gale 8 or severe gale 9 later in day.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, building rough or very rough.


##Weather)##

Heavy rain soon arriving, clearing to isolated showers in the evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Sunday, 25 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales/ severe gales at first.


##Wind)##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, gradually decreasing 6 or 7 by the evening, then backing South or SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Monday, 26 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales developing.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, gradually increasing South or SW 7 or gale 8, veering West overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, building rough.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain for a time


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Tuesday, 27 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales, then strong winds.


##Wind)##

West 7 or gale 8, gradually decreasing West or SW 6 or 7.


##State of sea)##

Rough, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
